prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: vertical social media cover image
Primary request: Photorealistic vertical 4:5 image (1080x1350 or closest). Japanese-style kyotei motorboat racing at night under bright stadium floodlights, with city lights blurred far in the background and calm dark water.
Subject: A single-seat kyotei racing boat about 3 m long, flat, low, and long relative to the racer, with a light-colored white or pale-grey hull. It has an OPEN cockpit with absolutely no canopy, roof, or windshield bubble. The racer crouches or kneels low in the open cockpit, leaning forward, both hands on a small steering wheel, wearing a completely plain full-face helmet and plain racing suit; face not visible. One outboard motor on the stern produces a large white spray plume. The boat banks into a tight left turn around one orange-and-white cylindrical turn buoy, with spray curving outward.
Composition/framing: Vertical 4:5. Boat entirely in the lower half. Keep the top 45% dark, empty, uncluttered negative space for a later title overlay.
Lighting/mood: Dramatic night race, bright stadium floodlights, realistic reflections and spray, distant city bokeh.
Constraints: Must unmistakably look like a Japanese kyotei racing boat, not an offshore powerboat and not an F1 tunnel boat. No recognizable real person.
Avoid: Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, signage, number plates, flags, emblems, or typographic marks anywhere in the image, including on boat, clothing, helmet, buoy, background, and structures.
verification: Visual inspection passed: open-cockpit single-seat kyotei boat, crouched racer, stern outboard, curved spray, cylindrical turn buoy, dark upper negative space; no text, numbers, logos, watermarks, signage, number plates, or flags observed.
